# Netanya Properties

> An independent guide to established real estate developers active in Netanya, Israel, covering their backgrounds, areas of activity and official websites.

Netanya Properties is an independent editorial directory about real estate developers in Netanya, Israel. It is not a real estate agency or broker, does not sell property and is not affiliated with the companies it profiles. Each profile links to the developer's official website.

## Key facts
- Website: https://netanya.properties/
- Topic: Residential real estate developers active in Netanya, Israel
- Developers profiled: Azorim, Aura Israel, Africa Israel Residences, Ashtrom Residences
- Contact: editor@netanya.properties

## Developer profiles
- [Azorim](https://netanya.properties/developers/azorim/): Azorim is a Tel Aviv Stock Exchange-listed residential developer that has been building homes across Israel for around six decades. Official website: https://www.azorim.co.il/en
- [Aura Israel](https://netanya.properties/developers/aura/): Aura is a Tel Aviv Stock Exchange-listed developer that concentrates on urban renewal, replacing ageing housing blocks with new residential districts. Official website: https://auraisrael.co.il/
- [Africa Israel Residences](https://netanya.properties/developers/africa-israel/): Africa Israel Residences is the TASE-listed homebuilding arm of the Africa Israel group, known for its Savyonim-branded residential communities. Official website: https://res.afi-g.com/en/pages/home.aspx
- [Ashtrom Residences](https://netanya.properties/developers/ashtrom/): Ashtrom Residences, formerly Ashdar, is the wholly owned residential development arm of the TASE-listed Ashtrom Group. Official website: https://www.ashtromegurim.co.il/en

## Projects mentioned
- Azorim Hofim EAST by Azorim (Park HaYam, Netanya): Residential towers
- Azorim Hofim WEST by Azorim (Park HaYam, Netanya): Residential tower
- N Sokolov by Azorim (Corner of Weizmann and Sokolov streets, north Netanya): Residential towers
- N Weizman by Azorim (Weizmann Street, north Netanya): Residential towers
- N HaHistadrut by Azorim (Corner of HaRav Kook and HaHistadrut streets, north Netanya): Residential buildings
- AURA THE STRIP (Netanya Ben Tzvi) by Aura Israel (Ben Zvi Street, central Netanya): Urban renewal (pinui-binui)
- Aura City Hadera (located in Hadera) by Aura Israel (Herbert Samuel / Sheshet HaYamim, Hadera city centre): Residential towers with commercial base
- Aura Jerusalem (located in Jerusalem) by Aura Israel (Talpiot, Jerusalem): Urban renewal
- Savyon Gardens by Africa Israel Residences (Park HaYam, Netanya): Residential tower
- Savyoney Hashmura by Africa Israel Residences (Near Ir Yamim, west Netanya): Residential towers (Africa Urban Renewal)
- Savyon City Towers by Africa Israel Residences (Borochov / Andrius / HaRav Kook streets, central Netanya): Urban renewal, residential towers
- Savion at the Lake by Africa Israel Residences (Agamim, west Netanya): Residential tower
- Galei Netanya by Ashtrom Residences (Park HaYam, Netanya): Residential towers
- GO YAFO TEL-AVIV (located in Tel Aviv) by Ashtrom Residences (Heinrich Heine Road, Jaffa, Tel Aviv-Jaffa): Residential towers (with Acro Real Estate)
- Ramat HaSharon Resort Strip (located in Ramat HaSharon) by Ashtrom Residences (Neve Gan, Ramat HaSharon): Residential buildings
- HADAR Givat Shmuel (located in Givat Shmuel) by Ashtrom Residences (Ramat Hadar, Givat Shmuel): Residential buildings
